source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
How a **force** uses army and **detachment rules**:

- In a **unified force**, army rules work as if the **force** were a single army. Example: a **DRUKHARI** **unified force** has 1 **pain token** pool, and the **force**, not each army, gains **pain tokens** under Power From Pain.
- Otherwise, every army in a **force** follows its own army rules.
- If both players in a **unified force** chose the same **detachments**, **detachment rules** work for the **force** as for a single army.
- Otherwise, a player's **detachment rules** affect only enemy units and that player's own army, in a **unified force** too. Example: in an **ADEPTUS ASTARTES** **unified force** with different **detachments**, a player can't use a **[stratagem](vsdata:core-rule/event-companion.using-stratagems-15-01)** on the teammate's units, even one that may target any friendly **ADEPTUS ASTARTES** unit, nor give them any **detachment rule** benefit, even one covering every friendly **ADEPTUS ASTARTES** unit.

armyRuleScope.otherwise: each army uses its own army rules

detachmentRuleScope.otherwise: affects only enemy units and units in the player's own army, even in a unified force
